import hashlib
from datetime import datetime

from chupa.config import load_config
from chupa.journal import EventType, Journal
from chupa.tickets import _intake_claims, ticket_path


def approve(repo, stem, clock):
    text = (repo / ticket_path(stem)).read_text()
    stamped, findings = _intake_claims(stem, text, True)
    if not findings:
        text = stamped
    data = text.encode()
    sha = hashlib.sha1(f\"blob {len(data)}\\0\".encode() + data).hexdigest()
    journal = Journal(load_config(None, cwd=repo).state_dir, clock)
    history = journal.read()
    if history and clock() < datetime.fromisoformat(history[-1].ts):
        journal = Journal(load_config(None, cwd=repo).state_dir, lambda: datetime.fromisoformat(history[-1].ts))
    journal.append(EventType.SIGNAL, {\"signal\": \"requisition_verdict\", \"verdict\": \"approve\", \"ticket_sha\": sha, \"provider\": \"fixture\", \"model\": \"fixture\", \"spec_version\": \"1.0\"}, ticket=stem)
